responsibility: Builds and manages IRA allocno live ranges over program points. It scans RTL on the loop-tree/allocno model, creates object live-range lists, records hard-register conflicts and call-crossing information, tracks register-pressure excess for pressure classes, constructs start/finish-point chains used by later conflict building, and can compress program points after transformations. Its live-range and conflict-hard-reg outputs are the basis for IRA interference analysis and later region-flattening updates.
